title: Convenience store/ diner
content: This time there was a convenience store that seemed to also serve as a fast food restaurant/ diner/ IHOP kind of place, but was small like a convenience store, as if the builders didn't understand the difference. It didn't have the aisles that a convenience store would have, but instead had tables and the self-serve food stuff that a 7-Eleven would have. When I was there, it was packed with people but I didn't recognize a single person. Lots of young women talking about getting their nails done (something I don't really care about). I had the feeling a bunch of us were going to get together and have a sleepover, which is weird because I'm in my late 40's and I don't do that anymore lol. I was sharing a table with a trucker guy who seemed nice enough. The colors of the store were white that seemed to also turn into beige. (Why do I always dream in beige? I am the same person who dreamed about the beige hotel yesterday.) Every time I try to pinpoint the color, I realize it's neither white nor beige. Whatever that means lol
